title: Score Twice, Prove Every Score: make adapter judgment recomputable

ciFast.note: Fast verification is not claimed until the exact v0.16.38 merge commit passes GitHub Actions.

ciDeep.note: This milestone hardens deterministic benchmark evidence verification. It does not run a model, train an adapter, or make a quality comparison.

deploy.note: The Pages deployment and production canary are not claimed until the exact Fast-verified merge commit is live.

liveProvider.note: No provider or browser-local model is invoked. The tests construct synthetic full rubric reviews and prove that unsupported score and preference evidence fails closed.

manualHuman.note: Codex is the declared sole judge. The protocol remains explicitly single-model evidence and this release performs no judgment.

strictLayeredEvaluation.note: The focused 36-test benchmark lane, 4,486-test software suite, production build, bundle budgets, 34-course main evaluation, release-history audit, and real-Chromium release story pass locally. These prove benchmark, software, compiler, build, and release-truth integrity only; no model was run or compared.

claims.summary: Model-judge totals and dimensions are accepted only when the verifier reconstructs both pass scorecards and the aggregate from two complete rubric-bound reviews.
Strict promotion evidence requires one A/B session and a distinct B/A session, exact order-specific review and scorecard hashes, and scoring timestamps before preference.
B/A outcomes reverse the anonymous label mapping before unblinding and expose per-artifact and candidate-minus-control score shifts instead of silently treating screen position as artifact identity.
Every winner names a concrete bound advantage or opposing defect, and every tie carries concrete evidence for both anonymous artifacts.
The milestone strengthens the ruler before candidate evaluation and records zero judgments, zero weight changes, and zero adapter-quality or speed claim.
